title: SQS, SNS, and Events
description: Use message queuing and pub/sub patterns with Amazon SQS and SNS in ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: Decoupled systems are easier to scale and maintain. This module teaches message queuing with SQS, pub/sub notifications with SNS, and how to combine them for event-driven ASP.NET Core applications.
whatYouLearn: Send and receive messages with Amazon SQS
Combine SQS and SNS for event-driven workflows
Handle errors and retries in messaging
